_comment: Places for tools/places.py. map: map header number (pokeheartgold include/constants/maps.h); x, y: tile, global for outdoor maps; dir: 0 up, 1 down, 2 left, 3 right; walk: [key, frames] pairs pressed after arriving; check: what to look at.

places.name: new_bark
places.check: outdoor town near the east edge of Johto; zoomed out, the corners reach map blocks that are not loaded

places.name: new_bark_edge
places.check: standing just past the middle of a map block: a zoomed-out view reaches blocks the game has not loaded (black, haze, or with FAR MAP the real map)

places.name: new_bark_border
places.check: on Route 29 at the New Bark border: New Bark's people are in view but the game only creates them on entering; with FAR MAP they stand there as ghosts

places.name: route_29
places.check: a route: walking across block boundaries, grass, the widescreen world while scrolling

places.name: route_29_edge
places.check: same, on a route: the far blocks are forest and paths

places.name: cherrygrove
places.check: town by the sea: water reaching the edges of the view

places.name: route_30
places.check: long north-south route: trees popping in at the edges of a zoomed-out view

places.name: violet
places.check: large city: many props (buildings), polygon load

places.name: azalea
places.check: town at the south edge of the map

places.name: goldenrod_east
places.check: the east of Goldenrod is in a block the game has not loaded: with FAR MAP its buildings, lamps and lit windows at night

places.name: goldenrod
places.check: the biggest city: speed, polygon and texture load

places.name: ecruteak
places.check: town with tall buildings and trees around it

places.name: olivine
places.check: harbour town at the west edge: the sea and the lighthouse

places.name: player_house
places.check: indoors: the black around the room is the game's own and must stay black (no void fill)

places.name: union_cave
places.check: a cave: darkness and the edges of a small map

places.name: ilex_forest
places.check: a forest map of several blocks: far trees, darkness under the canopy

places.name: dark_cave
places.check: a cave of several blocks: far blocks, the dark around the walls

places.name: safari_zone
places.check: the Safari Zone: its blocks are the areas placed in the save; far blocks get ground only

places.name: pokecenter
places.check: indoors at night: no night effects (the game does not darken interiors), no glow spilling into the black around the room
